verdict.rationale: Quantization is a fair axis for a local LLM runner, but nothing in the evidence pack documents integer quantization formats or bit-widths (low-bit through 8-bit) for reducing memory use. Mentions of the llama.cpp and Apple MLX runtimes are engine references, not documented quantization capabilities, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can reduce memory footprint using integer quantization ranging from very low-bit to 8-bit precision
